hero.badge: Available for full-time roles or freelance work · Open to international relocation
hero.subtitle: Frontend developer with 6 years of professional experience, also building full-stack web and mobile products.

about.title: About
about.bio: I gained 6 years of professional frontend experience at MobSuccess, GiFi, and Simform. Now based in Seoul, I also build personal web and mobile products end to end, from data modelling to deployment.

independent.description: Designing and building personal products alongside moving to Seoul and learning Korean.
independent.details: I created Cafes in Seoul, Bouldrr, and Kusodu, handling product design, frontend, backend, and deployment. These are personal projects, not client engagements.

simform.description: Built business dashboards and reusable component libraries for international B2B clients.
simform.details: Developed data-heavy React dashboards with TypeScript and created a design system shared across three client projects to speed up interface development.

gifi.description: Worked on GiFi’s e-commerce platform for a retail network of more than 900 stores.
gifi.details: Improved product-listing performance and built internal stock-management tools, with a focus on page speed and the purchasing journey.

mobsuccess.description: Built web interfaces and contributed to client projects at a mobile marketing agency.
mobsuccess.details: Developed React interfaces and gained my first experience shipping production code in an agency environment.

kusodu.description: An ad-free Sudoku app for iPhone and iPad, built with Swift and published on the App Store. It includes notes, error tracking, statistics, and progressive hints.

cafesInSeoul.description: Discover cafés in Seoul, search by neighbourhood, and browse reviews and ratings. Built with Next.js, Supabase, and Kakao Maps.

bouldrr.description: Track your bouldering sessions, view your progress, and share videos with the climbing community.

draftPredictions.description: Predict Karmine Corp’s champion picks during League of Legends LEC matches.

woeve.description: A bilingual French-English website for a product design studio, with scroll-triggered animations.

techStack.title: Skills
techStack.subtitle: Select a skill to learn more

react.description: My main UI library. I use Hooks, Context, and Zustand to build complex dashboards, real-time feeds, and interactive maps.

nextjs.description: My main framework: App Router, Server Components, API routes, and ISR. Used for Cafes in Seoul, Bouldrr, and this portfolio.

typescript.description: I write my projects in TypeScript, using strict mode, generics, and discriminated unions to catch errors earlier.

supabase.description: Authentication, PostgreSQL, real-time subscriptions, storage, and Edge Functions. I use it as the main backend for several projects.

tailwind.description: Utility-first CSS for prototyping and production, with custom design tokens, responsive layouts, and dark themes.

javascript.description: More than 6 years of frontend and backend practice with ES6+, asynchronous programming, Node.js, and browser APIs.

postgresql.description: Complex queries, migrations, row-level security, and stored functions. I design schemas that remain easy to evolve.

vercel.description: Continuous deployment, preview environments, and Edge Functions for getting applications online quickly.

git.description: Feature branches, rebasing, and readable commit histories. I use Git every day across my projects.

docker.description: Development environments, Docker Compose stacks, and self-hosted services. I also run my own infrastructure at home.

restapi.description: Design, development, and documentation of REST APIs, including authentication, rate limiting, and versioning.

auth.description: JWT, OAuth, sessions, and role-based access control for securing web and mobile applications.
